notes: The official DDW about page's 'Upcoming Dutch Design Week' section lists the 2027 edition as 23-31 October, confirming dates for the requested window. Location is confirmed via the site's consistent identification of Eindhoven as host city (site title 'dutch design week, 17-25 october 2026 eindhoven' and event description referencing Eindhoven). Demand set to High based on the about page's general claim of over 300,000 visitors and international designers/participants for the DDW event series, though no edition-specific 2027 attendance or hotel data was available. No other qualifying multi-day festivals or championships within 25km of Eindhoven were found on the two fetched pages, so only one edition is returned.
